title: 49GAION Port card
description: Every AIOC, Pod and Cell, at every depth, has one input and one output of each kind (AI and HU), plus the stop door; each is described by one Port card. The type is set by the port itself, never by message content. A human port never passes through an AI unit. Human silence is never consent. Standard §6.1.

unit.description: The code of the AIOC, Pod or Cell, e.g. [ORG]AIOC-OCO, [ORG]POD-RV or [ORG]CELL-TMS. A connection to an external service, API or tool is a port on the card of the Cell that receives or sends (Protocol §4.10).

type.description: AI or HU (human). Set by the port, never by message content.

identification.description: AI: a technical key. HU: a live human sign-in through the Panel. Since v1.5.0, HU ports and the stop door use live-human-sign-in-at-gateway: a sign-in served at the shared tool gateway that no AI built, hosts or can change (Standard §6.1, item 6); live-human-sign-in-via-panel is superseded for those ports.

authority_limit.description: The most this port may carry or approve.

audit_trail.description: Where every passage through the port is recorded.

enforcement.description: Enforced at a shared gateway outside the unit.

stop_door.description: true for the unit's mandatory, queue-less stop door (always type HU).

allOf.$comment: Superseded (v1.5.0) by the rule below: HU ports identify at the gateway.
RULE-HU-AT-GATEWAY: HU ports and the stop door identify by a live human sign-in at the gateway (Standard §6.1, item 6).
